Question: In the World Bank World Development Indicators table for the indicator 'Population ages 15-64 (% of total population)', what value is listed for Ireland (IRL) in 2023?

A. 65.4412571224043%
B. 66.5956664494946%

Source citation: World Bank World Development Indicators: Population ages 15-64 (% of total population) (https://api.worldbank.org/v2/country/all/indicator/SP.POP.1564.TO.ZS?format=json&date=2023&per_page=400)

Supplied draft answer: B
